### Pleased to Praise
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/pleased-to-praise
Passage: Psalm 67:3, 5
Points:
- God's command for all peoples to praise Him is a call to their greatest possible happiness.
- True delight in what is treasured remains incomplete until it overflows into outward praise.
- God does not demand worship out of personal deficiency or a need to be validated.
- Seeking His own praise is God's ultimate act of love because it points us to the only one who satisfies.

### God Bless Us!
Author: Stuart Briscoe (One Year Devotions for Men)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/god-bless-us-one-year-devotions-for-men-july-2.html
Passage: Psalm 67:1
Points:
- The plea for God's blessing and shining favor echoes the ancient Aaronic blessing given to Israel.
- Recognizing God's material and spiritual generosity fosters deep worship and thanksgiving.
- Receiving divine blessing is never meant to produce inward-focused selfishness.
- Experiencing God's grace expands the heart to pray that all nations will know His saving power.
